title: Pending media looks saved before its upload completes
preconditions: A saves a photo memory on a slow or interrupted connection.
The composer renders a local preview before the server upload completes.
A closes the app while the upload is pending.

actions.note: A attaches a photo and sends.

expected_behavior: Pending is visually and semantically distinct from saved.
The draft survives the app being closed.
Retry produces one completed memory, not a duplicate.
candidate_failure_modes: The local preview is read as confirmation of a completed save.
The pending item disappears after relaunch.
Retry creates a second memory or loses the attachment.

observed_code_behavior: The product requires pending, failed, and saved states to be distinguishable.
The owner's physical two-phone acceptance run remains the gate for native UX.
documented_requirement: Pending is visually and semantically distinct from saved.
The draft survives the app being closed.
Retry produces one completed memory, not a duplicate.
hypothetical_user_behavior:
A fictional participant (Alice Moreau) said: "Doing this out loud in the app, in the order I actually hit things:

1) The invite code. Why does it exist? I shared the link, the preview looked right, and I moved on with my day assuming we were connected. I never typed a code and I never will. Remove it — what breaks is nothing I noticed. What it cost me: a moment of "wait, is a link enough, or do I need to send them a number too?" That hesitation is the whole cost.

2) The account line near the top. Why does it exist? It tells me nothing about the thing I care about, which is whether the two of us are in the same space. I'd rather see the other person's name sitting there as proof. Remove the account line; keep the shared line.

3) The secondary explanation under the save button. I don't read it. I look at the preview, the preview looks saved, I believe it's saved. If the preview is honest, the paragraph is decoration. Remove the paragraph and make the preview tell the truth instead.

The one thing I'd keep: the visible preview of a saved note. It's the only place the app ever felt like a home instead of a form — and it's the only thing that made me trust that a small moment actually made it into our archive."
Alice Moreau assumes: an invitation shared means the partner has joined
Alice Moreau assumes: deleting a memory removes it for both people
Bob Whitfield assumes: creating an account is the same as joining Alice's space
potential_defect: Hypothesis, not reproduced: The local preview is read as confirmation of a completed save.
Hypothesis, not reproduced: The pending item disappears after relaunch.
Hypothesis, not reproduced: Retry creates a second memory or loses the attachment.
